title: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management

changes.label: Appointed
changes.role: Additional Director in the capacity of Executive Director
changes.reason: Appointment as an Additional Director in the capacity of Executive Director

profile.quote: Mr. Prithvi Vachani is currently serving as the Vice President at Dixon Technologies (India) Limited. A 2017 graduate of Bentley University, Mr. Prithvi quickly demonstrated his strategic acumen upon entering the professional arena. His exceptional foresight and leadership were notably displayed when he successfully orchestrated a major collaboration with boAt, India’s leading audio product company, resulting in the production of innovative twin wireless speakers.
profile.summary: Prithvi Vachani is a Bentley University graduate and current Vice President at Dixon Technologies who has demonstrated strategic leadership through successful collaborations with companies like boAt.

headline: Appointed: Prithvi Vachani, Additional Director in the capacity of Executive Director, from 30 Oct 2026
